responsibilities: Append items and wake waiting consumers.

summary: Coordinates incremental item dispatch between producers and consumers.

inner.summary: Signals that no further items will be added.

summary: Constructs an incremental dispatcher with a condition variable backed by its lock.
Appends an item and wakes waiting consumers unless dispatch is done.
Marks the dispatcher done and wakes waiting consumers.
Dispatches each added item to the callback until completion, then drains remaining items.
summary_step: 1. Tracks the next item index and copies available items under a read lock before invoking callbacks.
2. Loops until the done fuse is broken, waiting on the condition variable when no new items are available.
3. Rechecks completion after dispatching to avoid waiting after Done and drains any remaining items before returning.
